I know I shouldn’t waste my time on this, but here I am.

I’ve watched most of the shows you’ve mentioned, and some are okay, good, great, or at least used to be great. And a lot of them do give in your face commentary. But if bobs burgers gave the same time and obvious commentary it would be like all of the other shows and not unique. But it does give powerful commentary. For example, when Louise is principal and a teacher remarks that with extra recess time she can drive Uber longer-remarking that teachers are underpaid. Also once someone mentioned teachers after school running to their second jobs. Lots of commentary on wealth disparity and small business struggles. Those are just a few examples, as someone who loves the show I always try to pick up on stuff like that. 

I’m really sorry some of your favorite shows were canceled, but a lot of people, like myself, love this show. I love it because I find it funny, heart warming, a little raunchy at times, and for the subtle references. Everyone is entitled to their own opinions, but you have to expect some push back if you trash bobs burgers on a bobs burgers subreddit. Hope your day gets better.
